summary.headline: Planetary Combinations and Judgments
summary.text: Astrological judgments for planetary combinations: Saturn with Venus, Moon, and Sun, followed by Jupiter with the Sun and Moon, describing effects on wealth, alliances, women, honors, enmities, illness, rulership, and social status. Critical apparatus notes manuscript variants and emendations by Kroll, with a reference to folio 220.
